nodes.body_text: void BattleEngine::makeCommit(uint8_t out[8], uint32_t whoId, uint8_t move, const uint8_t salt[7]) const { uint8_t buf[26]; buf[0] = 'D'; buf[1] = 'C'; buf[2] = '3'; buf[3] = '5'; buf[4] = session & 0xFF; buf[5] = session >> 8; put32(buf + 6, nonceA); put32(buf + 10, nonceB); buf[14] = rnd; buf[15] = whoId >> 16; buf[16] = whoId >> 8; buf[17] = whoId; buf[18] = move; memcpy(buf + 19, salt, 7); uint8_t h[32]; dcSha256(buf, sizeof(buf), h); memcpy(out, h, 8); }

nodes.body_text: bool BattleEngine::challenge(uint32_t peerId, const PeerInfo *peers, int n, uint32_t now) { if (ph != Phase::IDLE || !selfCanBattle) return false; const PeerInfo *op = find(peers, n, peerId); if (!op || (op->f.flags & (FLAG_BUSY | FLAG_KO))) return false; oppId = peerId; challenger = true; session = (uint16_t)(rng() | 1); nonceA = rng(); nonceB = 0; fMe = {selfCls, selfLevel, selfHp, 0, 0}; // stats frozen for the battle startHpMe = selfHp; enter(Phase::CHALLENGING, now, CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT_MS); push(ev(EV_CHALLENGE_SENT)); return true; }

nodes.name: chooseMove
nodes.body_text: bool BattleEngine::chooseMove(uint8_t move, uint32_t now) { (void)now; if (ph != Phase::PICK || myMove != MOVE_NONE) return false; if (move < MOVE_STRIKE || move > MOVE_CHARGE) return false; myMove = move; for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) mySalt[i] = (uint8_t)rng(); return true; }

nodes.body_text: void BattleEngine::startBattle(const AdvFrame &opp, uint32_t now) { fOpp = {opp.cls, opp.level, opp.hp, 0, 0}; startHpOpp = opp.hp; rnd = 0; disengagedSince = 0; push(ev(EV_BATTLE_START)); startRound(now); }

nodes.name: startRound
nodes.body_text: void BattleEngine::startRound(uint32_t now) { rnd++; myMove = MOVE_NONE; havePeerCommit = false; enter(Phase::PICK, now, PICK_TIMEOUT_MS); push(ev(EV_ROUND_START)); }

nodes.name: finishRound
nodes.body_text: void BattleEngine::finishRound(uint8_t peerMove, uint32_t now) { RoundResult rr = resolveRound(fMe, myMove, fOpp, peerMove); BattleEvent e = ev(EV_ROUND_RESULT); e.myMove = myMove; e.oppMove = peerMove; e.rr = rr; push(e); lastReveal[0] = myMove; memcpy(lastReveal + 1, mySalt, 7); if (battleOver(fMe, fOpp, rnd)) { BattleEvent o = ev(EV_BATTLE_OVER); o.outcome = battleWinner(fMe, fOpp); push(o); enter(Phase::DONE, now, DONE_LINGER_MS); } else { startRound(now); } }

nodes.name: tick
nodes.signature: void BattleEngine::tick(uint32_t now, const PeerInfo *peers, int n)
nodes.body_text: void BattleEngine::tick(uint32_t now, const PeerInfo *peers, int n) { const PeerInfo *op = oppId ? find(peers, n, oppId) : nullptr; switch (ph) { case Phase::IDLE: { if (!selfCanBattle) break; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { const PeerInfo &p = peers[i]; if (p.f.state != W_CHALLENGE || p.f.opp != myId) continue; if (now - p.lastSeen > 2000) continue; if (p.id == ignoreId && p.f.session == ignoreSession) continue; oppId = p.id; session = p.f.session; nonceA = get32(p.f.data); pending = p.f; enter(Phase::CHALLENGED, now, CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT_MS); push(ev(EV_CHALLENGE_RECEIVED)); break; } break; } case Phase::CHALLENGING: { if (op && op->f.opp == myId && op->f.session == session && op->f.state == W_PICK && op->f.round == 1) { nonceB = get32(op->f.data); // they accepted startBattle(op->f, now); } else if (op && op->f.opp == myId && op->f.session == session && op->f.state == W_DECLINE) { push(ev(EV_CHALLENGE_DECLINED)); reset(now); } else if (op && op->f.state == W_CHALLENGE && op->f.opp == myId && myId < oppId) { // We challenged each other at the same time: the lower ID accepts theirs. session = op->f.session; nonceA = get32(op->f.data); nonceB = rng(); challenger = false; ignoreId = oppId; ignoreSession = session; startBattle(op->f, now); } else if ((int32_t)(now - phaseDeadline) >= 0) { push(ev(EV_CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT)); reset(now); } break; } case Phase::CHALLENGED: { bool stillChallenging = op && now - op->lastSeen < 3000 && op->f.state == W_CHALLENGE && op->f.opp == myId && op->f.session == session; if (!stillChallenging) { ignoreId = oppId; ignoreSession = session; push(ev(EV_CHALLENGE_CANCELLED)); reset(now); } else if ((int32_t)(now - phaseDeadline) >= 0) { respond(false, now); // no answer = decline } break; } case Phase::DECLINING: if ((int32_t)(now - phaseDeadline) >= 0) reset(now); break; case Phase::PICK: case Phase::COMMIT: case Phase::REVEAL: { // --- liveness checks --- if (!op || now - op->lastSeen > OPP_SILENT_ABORT_MS) { abort(AB_SILENT, now); break; } if (!engaged(op)) { if (!disengagedSince) disengagedSince = now; else if (now - disengagedSince > OPP_DISENGAGED_ABORT_MS) { abort(AB_LEFT, now); break; } } else disengagedSince = 0; if (now - phaseStart > PHASE_STALL_ABORT_MS) { abort(AB_STALLED, now); break; } // Remember the opponent's commitment (first one seen is binding). if (!havePeerCommit && engaged(op) && op->f.state == W_COMMIT && op->f.round == rnd) { memcpy(peerCommit, op->f.data, 8); havePeerCommit = true; } if (ph == Phase::PICK) { if (myMove == MOVE_NONE && (int32_t)(now - phaseDeadline) >= 0) { chooseMove(MOVE_STRIKE + rng() % 3, now); push(ev(EV_AUTO_MOVE)); } // Commit only once the opponent is in this round too, so it has // everything it needs (our nonce / previous reveal). if (myMove != MOVE_NONE && peerAtLeast(op, W_PICK, rnd)) { makeCommit(myCommit, myId, myMove, mySalt); enter(Phase::COMMIT, now, 0); } } else if (ph == Phase::COMMIT) { // Reveal only when BOTH commitments have been exchanged: we hold // theirs, and they hold ours (ACK flag, or they already revealed - // which they only do once they hold ours). This guarantees every // reveal can be checked against its commitment. bool theyHaveMine = engaged(op) && ((op->f.state == W_COMMIT && op->f.round == rnd && (op->f.flags & FLAG_ACK)) || peerAtLeast(op, W_REVEAL, rnd)); if (havePeerCommit && theyHaveMine) enter(Phase::REVEAL, now, 0); } else // REVEAL { uint8_t pm, ps[7]; if (takePeerReveal(op, pm, ps)) { bool valid = havePeerCommit && pm >= MOVE_STRIKE && pm <= MOVE_CHARGE; if (valid) { uint8_t check[8]; makeCommit(check, oppId, pm, ps); valid = memcmp(check, peerCommit, 8) == 0; } if (!valid) { BattleEvent c = ev(EV_CHEAT_DETECTED); c.oppMove = pm; push(c); BattleEvent o = ev(EV_BATTLE_OVER); o.outcome = +1; // cheater forfeits push(o); reset(now); break; } finishRound(pm, now); } } break; } case Phase::DONE: // Stay until the opponent has our final reveal (it reached DONE or left). if ((int32_t)(now - phaseDeadline) >= 0 || !engaged(op) || op->f.state == W_DONE) reset(now); break; } }

nodes.name: buildFrame
nodes.body_text: void BattleEngine::buildFrame(AdvFrame &f) const { memset(&f, 0, sizeof(f)); f.version = PROTO_VERSION; f.id = myId; bool frozen = ph == Phase::CHALLENGING || inBattle(); f.cls = frozen ? fMe.cls : selfCls; f.level = frozen ? fMe.level : selfLevel; f.hp = frozen ? startHpMe : selfHp; f.flags = selfFlags | (busy() ? FLAG_BUSY : 0) | (selfCanBattle ? 0 : FLAG_KO); uint32_t myNonce = challenger ? nonceA : nonceB; switch (ph) { case Phase::IDLE: case Phase::CHALLENGED: f.state = W_IDLE; return; case Phase::CHALLENGING: f.state = W_CHALLENGE; put32(f.data, nonceA); break; case Phase::DECLINING: f.state = W_DECLINE; break; case Phase::PICK: f.state = W_PICK; if (rnd == 1) put32(f.data, myNonce); else memcpy(f.data, lastReveal, 8); break; case Phase::COMMIT: f.state = W_COMMIT; memcpy(f.data, myCommit, 8); if (havePeerCommit) f.flags |= FLAG_ACK; break; case Phase::REVEAL: f.state = W_REVEAL; f.data[0] = myMove; memcpy(f.data + 1, mySalt, 7); break; case Phase::DONE: f.state = W_DONE; memcpy(f.data, lastReveal, 8); break; } f.opp = oppId; f.session = session; f.round = rnd; }

} bool needsMove() const { return ph == Phase::PICK && myMove == MOVE_NONE; } uint8_t chosenMove() const { return myMove; } uint32_t opponent() const { return oppId; } uint8_t round() const { return rnd; } uint32_t deadline() const { return phaseDeadline; } const Fighter &me() const { return fMe; } const Fighter &them() const { return fOpp; } uint8_t myMaxHpAtStart() const { return startHpMe; } uint8_t oppMaxHpAtStart() const { return startHpOpp; } private: // identity / self uint32_t myId = 0; RandomFn rng = nullptr; uint8_t selfCls = 0, selfLevel = 1, selfHp = 0, selfFlags = 0; bool selfCanBattle = true; // battle Phase ph = Phase::IDLE; bool challenger = false; uint32_t oppId = 0; uint16_t session = 0; uint32_t nonceA = 0, nonceB = 0; // challenger / acceptor nonces uint8_t rnd = 0; uint8_t myMove = MOVE_NONE; uint8_t mySalt[7]; uint8_t myCommit[8]; uint8_t lastReveal[8]; // my reveal of the previous round uint8_t peerCommit[8]; bool havePeerCommit = false; Fighter fMe, fOpp; uint8_t startHpMe = 0, startHpOpp = 0; AdvFrame pending; // challenger's frame while we decide // timers uint32_t phaseStart = 0, phaseDeadline = 0, disengagedSince = 0; nodes.body_text: static Command parse(char *s) { Command c = {CMD_UNKNOWN, 0}; for (char *p = s; *p; p++) *p = tolower(*p); char *arg = strchr(s, ' '); if (arg) { *arg++ = 0; while (*arg == ' ') arg++; } if (is(s, "h", "help", "?")) c.type = CMD_HELP; else if (is(s, "l", "list", "ls")) c.type = CMD_LIST; else if (is(s, "y", "yes", "accept")) c.type = CMD_ACCEPT; else if (is(s, "n", "no", "decline")) c.type = CMD_DECLINE; else if (is(s, "1", "strike")) { c.type = CMD_MOVE; c.arg = MOVE_STRIKE; } else if (is(s, "2", "block", "guard")) { c.type = CMD_MOVE; c.arg = MOVE_BLOCK; } else if (is(s, "3", "charge")) { c.type = CMD_MOVE; c.arg = MOVE_CHARGE; } else if (is(s, "stats", "me")) c.type = CMD_STATS; else if (is(s, "auto", "bot")) c.type = CMD_AUTO; else if (is(s, "heal")) c.type = CMD_HEAL; else if (is(s, "factory-reset")) c.type = CMD_RESET; else if (is(s, "touchtest")) c.type = CMD_TOUCHTEST; else if (is(s, "bright", "brightness", "dim")) { c.type = CMD_BRIGHT; if (!arg || !*arg) c.arg = -1; // show current else if (*arg == '+') c.arg = 0; // next level else c.arg = atoi(arg); // 1..5 } else if (is(s, "c", "challenge", "fight") && arg && *arg) { c.type = CMD_CHALLENGE; if (strncmp(arg, "dc35-", 5) == 0) arg += 5; if (strlen(arg) >= 4) c.arg = CMD_ID_FLAG | (int32_t)(strtoul(arg, nullptr, 16) & 0xFFFFFF); else c.arg = atoi(arg); } return c; }

nodes.name: inputPoll
nodes.body_text: bool inputPoll(Command &c) { // BOOT button (active low): short press = CMD_BUTTON (on release), // hold 1.5 s = toggle auto-play (lets a second board run without Serial). bool down = digitalRead(PIN_BOOT_BTN) == LOW; uint32_t now = millis(); if (down != btnWasDown && now - btnChangedAt > 40) { btnWasDown = down; btnChangedAt = now; if (down) btnLongFired = false; else if (!btnLongFired) { c = {CMD_BUTTON, 0}; return true; } } if (down && btnWasDown && !btnLongFired && now - btnChangedAt >= LONG_PRESS_MS) { btnLongFired = true; c = {CMD_AUTO, 0}; return true; } while (Serial.available()) { char ch = Serial.read(); if (ch == '\r') continue; if (ch == '\n') { line[len] = 0; len = 0; char *s = line; while (*s == ' ') s++; if (!*s) continue; c = parse(s); return true; } if (len < sizeof(line) - 1) line[len++] = ch; } return false; }

XP_WIN : (outcome == 0 ? XP_DRAW : XP_LOSS); a.gained = base * a.percent / 100; } rememberOpponent(oppId, now); p.xp += a.gained; while (p.level < MAX_LEVEL && p.xp >= playerXpToNext(p)) { p.xp -= playerXpToNext(p); p.level++; p.hp = playerMaxHp(p); // level-up = full heal (and clears a KO) p.ko = 0; a.leveledUp = true; } if (p.level >= MAX_LEVEL) p.xp = 0; return a; }

nodes.body_text: RoundResult resolveRound(Fighter &a, uint8_t ma, Fighter &b, uint8_t mb) { RoundResult r = {0, FX_STANDOFF, 0, 0}; // A full meter turns a Strike into an unblockable one (it beats Block) bool aUnblockable = ma == MOVE_STRIKE && mb == MOVE_BLOCK && a.meter >= METER_MAX; bool bUnblockable = mb == MOVE_STRIKE && ma == MOVE_BLOCK && b.meter >= METER_MAX; int8_t w; if (aUnblockable) w = +1; else if (bUnblockable) w = -1; else if (ma == mb) w = 0; else w = beats(ma, mb) ? +1 : -1; if (w == 0) { if (ma == MOVE_STRIKE) { r.effect = FX_CLASH; // both hits land hit(a, b, r.dmgToB); hit(b, a, r.dmgToA); } else if (ma == MOVE_CHARGE) { r.effect = FX_BOTH_CHARGE; a.meter = addMeter(a.meter); b.meter = addMeter(b.meter); } return r; } Fighter &W = (w > 0) ? a : b; Fighter &L = (w > 0) ? b : a; uint8_t mw = (w > 0) ? ma : mb; bool unblockable = (w > 0) ? aUnblockable : bUnblockable; if (unblockable) { r.effect = FX_UNBLOCKABLE; W.meter = 0; } else if (mw == MOVE_STRIKE) r.effect = FX_HIT; else if (mw == MOVE_BLOCK) r.effect = FX_COUNTER; else { r.effect = FX_CHARGE_BREAK; W.meter = addMeter(W.meter); } hit(W, L, (w > 0) ? r.dmgToB : r.dmgToA); r.winner = w; return r; }

nodes.body_text: static int readRaw(int &rx, int &ry) { bus2.beginTransaction(SPISettings(2000000, MSBFIRST, SPI_MODE0)); digitalWrite(PIN_TOUCH_CS, LOW); int z1 = channel(0xB1); int z2 = channel(0xC1); int z = z1 + (4095 - z2); if (z >= TOUCH_PRESSURE_MIN) { channel(0xD1); // first sample is noisy rx = (channel(0xD1) + channel(0xD1)) / 2; // X ry = (channel(0x91) + channel(0x91)) / 2; // Y } channel(0x90); // power down, pen IRQ enabled digitalWrite(PIN_TOUCH_CS, HIGH); bus2.endTransaction(); return z; }

nodes.name: Sim
nodes.body_text: struct Sim { std::vector<SimBadge> b; std::mt19937 rnd; double loss = 0.0; uint32_t now = 1000; // optional in-flight frame tamper: (from, to, frame&) std::function<void(SimBadge &, SimBadge &, AdvFrame &)> tamper; explicit Sim(uint32_t seed) : rnd(seed) { engineRng.seed(seed * 7919 + 1); b.reserve(8); // keep SimBadge references stable } SimBadge &add(uint32_t id) { b.emplace_back(); SimBadge &x = b.back(); x.id = id; return x; } void init() { for (auto &x : b) x.eng.begin(x.id, rngFn); } uint32_t rand(uint32_t n) { return n ? rnd() % n : 0; } void deliver(SimBadge &from, SimBadge &to, const AdvFrame &frame) { AdvFrame f = frame; if (tamper) tamper(from, to, f); for (auto &p : to.peers) if (p.id == from.id) { p.f = f; p.lastSeen = now; p.rssi = -50; p.rssiAvg = -50; return; } PeerInfo p{}; p.id = from.id; p.f = f; p.lastSeen = p.firstSeen = now; p.rssi = -50; p.rssiAvg = -50; to.peers.push_back(p); } void step(uint32_t dt = 5) { now += dt; for (auto &x : b) { // keep self stats fresh while idle x.eng.setSelf(x.cls, x.level, x.hp, x.hp > 0, 0); // scripted human behaviour if (x.pending && now >= x.actAt) { if (x.pending == 1 && x.eng.phase() == Phase::CHALLENGED) x.eng.respond(x.acceptPolicy == 1, now); if (x.pending == 2 && x.eng.needsMove()) x.eng.chooseMove(MOVE_STRIKE + rand(3), now); x.pending = 0; } x.eng.tick(now, x.peers.data(), (int)x.peers.size()); BattleEvent e; while (x.eng.pollEvent(e)) { x.events.push_back(e); if (e.type == EV_CHALLENGE_RECEIVED && x.acceptPolicy >= 0) { x.pending = 1; x.actAt = now + rand(x.maxDelay); } if (e.type == EV_ROUND_START && x.picksMoves) { x.pending = 2; x.actAt = now + rand(x.maxDelay); } } // transmit if (x.present && now >= x.nextTx) { AdvFrame f; x.eng.buildFrame(f); for (auto &y : b) if (&y != &x && y.present && (rnd() / (double)rnd.max()) >= loss) deliver(x, y, f); uint32_t base = x.eng.inBattle() ? 40 : 125; x.nextTx = now + base + rand(10); // BLE adds random jitter } } } void runFor(uint32_t ms) { uint32_t end = now + ms; while (now < end) step(); } // Run until badge i has heard badge j (or give up after maxMs). void waitHeard(size_t i, size_t j, uint32_t maxMs = 20000) { uint32_t end = now + maxMs; auto heard = [&] { for (auto &p : b[i].peers) if (p.id == b[j].id) return true; return false; }; while (now < end && !heard()) step(); } bool allIdle() const { for (auto &x : b) if (x.eng.phase() != Phase::IDLE) return false; return true; } void runUntilIdle(uint32_t maxMs) { uint32_t end = now + maxMs; runFor(200); while (now < end && !allIdle()) step(); runFor(500); } }

nodes.body_text: static void checkConsistent(SimBadge &A, SimBadge &B, const char *tag, uint32_t seed) { const BattleEvent *oa = lastEv(A, EV_BATTLE_OVER), *ob = lastEv(B, EV_BATTLE_OVER); CHECK(oa && ob, "%s seed %u: battle did not finish on both (A=%d B=%d, aborts A=%d B=%d)", tag, seed, oa != nullptr, ob != nullptr, countEv(A, EV_ABORTED), countEv(B, EV_ABORTED)); if (!oa || !ob) return; CHECK(oa->outcome == -ob->outcome, "%s seed %u: outcomes not mirrored (%d vs %d)", tag, seed, oa->outcome, ob->outcome); CHECK(A.eng.me().hp == B.eng.them().hp && A.eng.them().hp == B.eng.me().hp, "%s seed %u: HP mismatch A(%d,%d) B(%d,%d)", tag, seed, A.eng.me().hp, A.eng.them().hp, B.eng.me().hp, B.eng.them().hp); // round-by-round moves mirrored std::vector<const BattleEvent *> ra, rb; for (auto &e : A.events) if (e.type == EV_ROUND_RESULT) ra.push_back(&e); for (auto &e : B.events) if (e.type == EV_ROUND_RESULT) rb.push_back(&e); CHECK(ra.size() == rb.size(), "%s seed %u: round count %zu vs %zu", tag, seed, ra.size(), rb.size()); for (size_t i = 0; i < ra.size() && i < rb.size(); i++) CHECK(ra[i]->myMove == rb[i]->oppMove && ra[i]->oppMove == rb[i]->myMove && ra[i]->rr.winner == -rb[i]->rr.winner, "%s seed %u: round %zu differs", tag, seed, i + 1); CHECK(countEv(A, EV_CHEAT_DETECTED) == 0 && countEv(B, EV_CHEAT_DETECTED) == 0, "%s seed %u: false cheat detection", tag, seed); }

} // spot checks of the triangle Fighter a = {CLASS_HACKER, 1, 12, 0, 0}, b = {CLASS_HACKER, 1, 12, 0, 0}; CHECK(resolveRound(a, MOVE_STRIKE, b, MOVE_CHARGE).winner == +1, "Strike should beat Charge"); CHECK(resolveRound(a, MOVE_BLOCK, b, MOVE_STRIKE).winner == +1, "Block should beat Strike"); CHECK(resolveRound(a, MOVE_CHARGE, b, MOVE_BLOCK).winner == +1, "Charge should beat Block"); Fighter c = {CLASS_HACKER, 1, 12, METER_MAX, 0}, d = {CLASS_HACKER, 1, 12, 0, 0}; lv <= MAX_LEVEL; lv++) CHECK(levelMaxHp(lv) == HITS_TO_KO * levelHitDamage(lv) && levelHitDamage(lv) == BASE_HIT_DMG * (1 + (lv - 1) / LEVELS_PER_TIER), "level %d scaling wrong", lv); CHECK(levelHitDamage(1) == 1 && levelMaxHp(1) == HITS_TO_KO, "level 1 should hit for 1"); Fighter e = {CLASS_HACKER, 1, 2, 0, 0}, f = {CLASS_HACKER, 7, 6, 0, 0}; RoundResult cl = resolveRound(e, MOVE_STRIKE, f, MOVE_STRIKE); CHECK(cl.effect == FX_CLASH && cl.dmgToA == levelHitDamage(7) && cl.dmgToB == levelHitDamage(1), "clash: both hits should land with each attacker's damage"); // gap -1 CHECK(a.gained == XP_WIN / 2, "win vs 1 lower: +%lu", (unsigned long)a.gained); p.xp = 0; a = playerApplyBattle(p, +1, 10, 9, 0x2003, t); // gap +4 -> capped at +3 CHECK(a.gained == XP_WIN * 250 / 100, "win vs much stronger: +%lu", (unsigned long)a.gained); p.level = 5; p.xp = 0; a = playerApplyBattle(p, -1, 10, 8, 0x2004, t); // loss vs stronger: not boosted CHECK(a.gained == XP_LOSS && a.percent == 100, "loss vs stronger should be base XP: +%lu", (unsigned long)a.gained);
